visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a woman in beige bear-patterned pajamas standing in a home environment. She has messy hair and a digital mustache filter on her face. She performs rhythmic hand gestures, touching her index fingers together and crossing her arms while looking at the camera with a neutral expression. (2) There is a sharp cut to the same woman in a hair salon setting. Her hair is now perfectly straight and black, and she wears a black tube top. She replicates the same rhythmic hand gestures, smiling slightly. (3) The scene shifts to show the interior of the hair salon, featuring sleek black washing basins and modern chairs against a bright white background. Text overlays appear on the screen to introduce the specific hair treatment service being promoted. (4) The woman is now seated in a salon chair with a blue cape. A male stylist in a black professional uniform stands behind her, assessing her hair texture and discussing the treatment. They engage in a conversational dialogue about her previous hair bleaching history. (5) A series of close-up montage shots follow, showing the hair treatment process. The stylist's hands apply a liquid product to wet hair strands, combing through them carefully to ensure even coverage. The hair appears glossy and saturated during this stage. (6) The woman is then shown lying back at a washing station while the stylist rinses her hair with water. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clean, professional environment. (7) Final result shots show the woman's hair being combed through after the treatment. The hair is remarkably shiny, reflecting the studio lights, and moves fluidly with a smooth texture and lack of frizz. (8) A split-screen comparison appears with labels clearly demonstrating the difference in hair health and texture. The woman returns to the frame to provide a final recommendation to the audience.
